text.en: The chart is real, the chair is real, and the person sitting in it is a real human who trusted the appointment system. Your hands are doing that thing where they pretend they've never held an instrument before.
text.zh: 病历是真的，椅子是真的，坐在上面的也是一个真真切切信任了预约系统的活人。你的手又开始装作这辈子没拿过器械的样子。

text.en: Breathe, introduce yourself, go slow
text.zh: 深呼吸，自我介绍，慢慢来

resultText.en: You say your name out loud and your shoulders drop two inches. Slow turns out to be steady.
resultText.zh: 你把名字说出口，肩膀一下子松了下来。慢，原来就是稳。

text.en: Move fast to look competent
text.zh: 动作麻利点显得专业

resultText.en: You look efficient and feel like a hummingbird. You finish, but your heart rate files a complaint.
resultText.zh: 你看着很利落，心里却像只蜂鸟。活儿干完了，但你的心率提出了投诉。

text.en: Quietly ask faculty to shadow
text.zh: 悄悄请带教在旁边盯着

resultText.en: Faculty hovers and nods. The patient never notices; you learn three things you'd have missed.
resultText.zh: 带教在旁边盯着、点头。病人毫无察觉，你学到了三个本来会漏掉的细节。

text.en: Your patient grips the armrest before you've touched a single thing and asks the oldest question in dentistry: will it hurt?
text.zh: 你还什么都没碰，病人就攥紧了扶手，问出了牙科界最古老的那个问题：会疼吗？

text.en: Be honest: a pinch, then numb
text.zh: 如实说：先有点扎，然后就麻了

resultText.en: "A small pinch, then nothing." They believe you because it's true, and it goes exactly that way.
resultText.zh: “先一点点扎，然后就没感觉了。”因为是真话，他们信了，结果也确实如此。

text.en: Promise they'll feel nothing at all
text.zh: 保证一点都不会疼

resultText.en: They feel the pinch you swore wouldn't come. Trust takes a small, avoidable dent.
resultText.zh: 他们还是感觉到了你发誓不会有的那一下。信任出现了一道本可避免的小裂痕。

text.en: Narrate every step before you do it
text.zh: 每一步动手前都先讲一遍

resultText.en: Talking it through eats a few minutes but the white-knuckle grip relaxes. Worth it.
resultText.zh: 讲解花了几分钟，但那双攥白的手松开了。值。

text.en: Twenty minutes past the appointment time, your chair is empty and your quota requirement is staring at you like an unread email.
text.zh: 约定时间过了二十分钟，你的椅位空着，而你的临床指标正像一封未读邮件一样盯着你。

text.en: Call them and reschedule kindly
text.zh: 打电话过去，好好改个时间

resultText.en: Turns out the bus stranded them. You rebook; they show up early next time, grateful.
resultText.zh: 原来是公交把他们困住了。你重新约了时间，下次他们提早就来了，满是感激。

text.en: Use the empty slot to study
text.zh: 用这段空当复习

resultText.en: You crack open notes and actually absorb a chapter. The day isn't wasted, just rerouted.
resultText.zh: 你翻开笔记，居然真把一章看进去了。这天没浪费，只是改道了。

text.en: Spiral about your requirement count
text.zh: 为指标焦虑到原地打转

resultText.en: You spend the slot doing anxiety math. The numbers don't move; your stress does.
resultText.zh: 你花了一整段时间做焦虑算术。数字没动，焦虑倒是涨了。

text.en: Ask the desk for a walk-in
text.zh: 去前台问有没有 walk-in

resultText.en: The desk hands you a walk-in screening. Unexpected case, unexpectedly good practice.
resultText.zh: 前台塞给你一个临时检查的病人。意外的病例，意外地很练手。

text.en: Your patient rushes in apologizing, hair still wet, coat half on. There's not really enough time left to do the whole plan.
text.zh: 病人冲进来连声道歉，头发还是湿的，外套挂了一半。说实话，剩下的时间已经不够做完整个计划了。

text.en: Do what fits, schedule the rest
text.zh: 能做多少做多少，剩下的再约

resultText.en: You handle the priority step well and rebook the rest. Honest, tidy, no drama.
resultText.zh: 你把最要紧的一步做漂亮了，其余的另约。诚实、干净、不闹腾。

text.en: Try to cram the full plan in
text.zh: 硬塞，把全部计划做完

resultText.en: You finish by sprinting and your notes suffer. The tooth's fine; your focus is fried.
resultText.zh: 你一路狂奔做完了，病历记得潦草。牙没问题，你的脑子先烧了。

text.en: Let them know they were quite late
text.zh: 让他们知道这次真的挺晚

resultText.en: They get quieter and apologize more. You realize the lecture helped no one.
resultText.zh: 他们变得更安静，道歉得更多了。你意识到这通说教谁都没帮上。

text.en: Three reasonable options, one patient, and that quiet pressure to pick the plan that looks most impressive on your case log.
text.zh: 三个都说得通的方案，一个病人，还有那股悄悄的压力——选个在你病例本上最好看的。

text.en: Pick what's best for the patient
text.zh: 选对病人最好的那个

resultText.en: You choose the simpler, sturdier plan. Less flashy for your log, exactly right for them.
resultText.zh: 你选了更简单、更耐用的方案。病例本上不够炫，但对他们刚刚好。

text.en: Pick the more impressive procedure
text.zh: 选更能撑场面的术式

resultText.en: Great for your portfolio, heavier for them. Faculty raises one slow eyebrow.
resultText.zh: 对你的作品集很好，对他们负担更重。带教缓缓挑了挑眉。

text.en: Talk all three through with faculty
text.zh: 把三个方案都跟带教过一遍

resultText.en: Faculty walks you through the tradeoffs. Slower today, sharper for every plan after.
resultText.zh: 带教带你把利弊一条条捋了。今天慢了点，但往后每个方案你都更利落了。

text.en: You're prepped, gloved, and ready, but faculty is across the clinic mid-conversation. Your patient waits; your gloves slowly fog with patience.
text.zh: 你准备好了，戴好手套，万事俱备，但带教在诊室另一头聊得正起劲。病人等着，你的手套也在耐心里慢慢起雾。

text.en: Chat with your patient while you wait
text.zh: 等的时候跟病人聊聊天

resultText.en: You learn they're a beekeeper. The wait flies by and rapport quietly doubles.
resultText.zh: 你听说他们是养蜂人。等待飞快过去，关系悄悄翻了倍。

text.en: Politely flag that you're ready
text.zh: 礼貌地示意你这边好了

resultText.en: You catch faculty's eye with a small wave. They come over sooner; nobody's annoyed.
resultText.zh: 你一个小招手抓住带教的目光。他们提早过来了，谁都没不高兴。

text.en: Start the irreversible step solo
text.zh: 不等了，自己先做不可逆的一步

resultText.en: You jump ahead and faculty has to pause you. A teachable moment, the awkward kind.
resultText.zh: 你抢跑了，带教不得不叫停你。一个可以学习的瞬间——尴尬的那种。

text.en: It's just an inferior alveolar block, which you've done on the manikin a hundred times. The needle suddenly feels like it weighs a kilogram.
text.zh: 不过是个下牙槽神经阻滞，你在仿真头模上做过一百遍了。这根针忽然重得像有一公斤。

text.en: Pause, picture the landmarks, go
text.zh: 停一秒，在脑里过一遍标志点，再下针

resultText.en: You find the coronoid notch, the angle's right, the patient feels almost nothing. Clean.
resultText.zh: 你摸到喙突切迹，角度对了，病人几乎没感觉。漂亮。

text.en: Just get it over with quickly
text.zh: 赶紧扎完算了

resultText.en: Speed beats precision today; you reposition once. Numb in the end, nerves still buzzing.
resultText.zh: 今天快赢了准，你重新调整了一次。最后是麻了，可你的神经还在嗡嗡。

text.en: Ask faculty to watch this one
text.zh: 请带教看着这一针

resultText.en: They confirm your angle before you advance. Your hand steadies the moment they nod.
resultText.zh: 他们在你进针前确认了角度。他们一点头，你的手就稳了。

text.en: The case is taking longer than planned, your next patient is already in the waiting room, and the clinic clock has no sympathy whatsoever.
text.zh: 这个病例做得比计划久，下一位病人已经在候诊区了，而诊室的钟对你毫无同情心。

text.en: Finish this one properly
text.zh: 先把这个好好做完

resultText.en: You don't cut corners. The next patient waits a bit, both end up well treated.
resultText.zh: 你没偷工减料。下一位多等了一会儿，但两位最后都治得妥妥的。

text.en: Have the desk warn the next patient
text.zh: 让前台提前知会下一位

resultText.en: A heads-up turns frustration into patience. Communication does what speed couldn't.
resultText.zh: 一句提前知会把烦躁变成了耐心。沟通做到了速度做不到的事。

text.en: Panic-rush to claw back time
text.zh: 慌慌张张抢时间

resultText.en: Hurrying makes you drop an instrument and restart a step. Time saved: negative.
resultText.zh: 一急你掉了个器械，又得重做一步。省下的时间：负数。

text.en: Your patient hears the estimate and goes quiet. You can see them doing the same math everyone does, the kind where the tooth competes with the grocery bill.
text.zh: 病人听到估价后沉默了。你看得出他们在做那道每个人都会做的算术——牙和买菜钱抢预算的那种。

text.en: Walk through phased, cheaper options
text.zh: 讲讲分期、更省钱的方案

resultText.en: You map a do-it-in-stages plan. Their shoulders drop; the tooth and the budget can coexist.
resultText.zh: 你给他们排了个分阶段做的计划。他们松了口气，牙和预算可以共存了。

text.en: Let the silence do the selling
text.zh: 用沉默替你推方案

resultText.en: The awkward pause pushes them to agree, but they leave looking cornered, not cared for.
resultText.zh: 尴尬的停顿逼他们点了头，可他们走时像被将了军，而不是被照顾。

text.en: Loop in the financial coordinator
text.zh: 叫上费用协调员一起看

resultText.en: The coordinator finds a plan you didn't know existed. Teamwork, and a relieved patient.
resultText.zh: 协调员找到了一个你都不知道的方案。团队协作，外加一个松了口气的病人。

text.en: Your patient's English and your handful of their language are both running on fumes, but the worried look needs no translation.
text.zh: 病人的英语和你那点对方的语言都快见底了，但那副担忧的神情根本不需要翻译。

text.en: Call the interpreter line, go slow
text.zh: 接通翻译专线，慢慢来

resultText.en: The interpreter bridges everything. Consent is real consent now, and they visibly relax.
resultText.zh: 翻译把一切都接通了。现在的知情同意是真的知情同意，他们肉眼可见地放松了。

text.en: Lean on diagrams and gestures
text.zh: 靠画图和手势

resultText.en: You sketch the tooth and mime the steps. Imperfect, but the smile back says it landed.
resultText.zh: 你画了牙，比划了步骤。不完美，但回过来的那个笑说明传达到了。

text.en: Push through with simple English
text.zh: 用简单英语硬聊过去

resultText.en: You get the gist across but miss a worry they couldn't phrase. It surfaces awkwardly later.
resultText.zh: 大意是传到了，可你漏掉了一个他们说不出口的担忧，后来别扭地冒了出来。

text.en: A six-year-old sits in the big chair swinging their legs, deciding in real time whether you are a friend or the enemy of all teeth.
text.zh: 一个六岁小孩坐在大椅子上晃着腿，正实时判断你到底是朋友，还是全体牙齿的公敌。

text.en: Turn the exam into a game
text.zh: 把检查变成游戏

resultText.en: You count teeth like treasure and let them hold the mirror. Giggles replace tears. Win.
resultText.zh: 你像数宝藏一样数牙，还让他们拿镜子。咯咯笑取代了眼泪。赢了。

text.en: Stay strictly business to save time
text.zh: 为省时间一切照流程走

resultText.en: Efficient, but the legs stop swinging and the trust along with them. Slower would've been faster.
resultText.zh: 是高效，可晃动的腿停了，信任也跟着停了。慢一点反而会更快。

text.en: Coach the parent to help
text.zh: 教家长一起配合

resultText.en: You give the parent a job and the kid a hand to hold. The room calms by half.
resultText.zh: 你给家长派了任务，给孩子留了只手牵着。整个房间的紧张少了一半。

text.en: Multiple issues, a thick medical history, and a patient who's seen four other clinics. This is the case your textbook called "beyond the scope of this chapter."
text.zh: 好几个问题，厚厚的病史，还有一个跑过四家诊所的病人。这就是你课本里写着“超出本章范围”的那种病例。

text.en: Break it into a phased plan
text.zh: 拆成分阶段的计划

resultText.en: You sequence it step by patient step. Suddenly the impossible just looks like a long list.
resultText.zh: 你一步一步给它排了序。忽然之间，不可能只是一张长清单而已。

text.en: Refer the hardest part to a specialist
text.zh: 把最难的部分转给专科

resultText.en: Knowing your limit is a skill too. The patient gets better care; your log loses a flashy entry.
resultText.zh: 知道自己的边界也是一种本事。病人得到更好的照顾，你的病例本少了个亮眼条目。

text.en: Take the whole thing on yourself
text.zh: 整个全包下来自己做

resultText.en: Ambitious. You learn a ton and lose a weekend of sleep to anxious chart-reading.
resultText.zh: 很有志气。你学到一大堆，也搭进一个周末的睡眠去焦虑地翻病历。

text.en: Something unexpected shows up partway through, nothing dangerous, just not in the lesson plan. The patient is watching your eyes for a reaction.
text.zh: 做到一半冒出个没料到的情况，不危险，只是不在教案里。病人正盯着你的眼睛找反应。

text.en: Keep a calm face, reassess
text.zh: 面不改色，重新评估

resultText.en: You keep your voice level, step back, and adjust. The tooth can wait; your composure can't.
resultText.zh: 你声音平稳，退一步，调整方案。牙可以等，你的镇定不能丢。

text.en: Let the worry show on your face
text.zh: 把慌张写在脸上

resultText.en: Your face does the talking and the patient tenses up. You fix it, but the room got harder first.
resultText.zh: 你的表情先开了口，病人也跟着紧张。你最后解决了，但房间先变难了。

text.en: Calmly call faculty over
text.zh: 镇定地请带教过来

resultText.en: "Could you take a look?" handled smoothly. Faculty confirms your read; everyone exhales.
resultText.zh: “能过来看一眼吗？”处理得很从容。带教确认了你的判断，大家都松了口气。

text.en: Patients are gone, the clinic's emptying, and your charting backlog sits there like a browser with eighty tabs open. Future-you is begging present-you to write it down right.
text.zh: 病人都走了，诊室在清场，你那堆没写完的病历像开了八十个标签页的浏览器一样杵着。未来的你正求现在的你把它好好写清楚。

text.en: Chart thoroughly now while it's fresh
text.zh: 趁记忆新鲜，现在就认真写

resultText.en: You write clean, complete notes. Tired tonight, blessed at next week's recall appointment.
resultText.zh: 你写下干净完整的记录。今晚累，但下周复诊时你会感谢自己。

text.en: Jot the bare minimum and go home
text.zh: 随便记几笔就回家

resultText.en: You're out the door fast. Next visit you stare at "tx done, pt ok" and have no idea.
resultText.zh: 你飞快地出了门。下次复诊看着“做了治疗，病人ok”，一脸茫然。

text.en: Co-write with the assistant, split it
text.zh: 和助手分工一起写

resultText.en: Two sets of memory beat one. You finish faster and catch a detail you'd have missed.
resultText.zh: 两个人的记忆胜过一个。你写得更快，还补上了一个本会漏掉的细节。

text.en: Today you've got a dental assistant who's done this longer than you've been in dental school. Four-handed dentistry only works if you actually let the other two hands help.
text.zh: 今天给你配了个助手，干这行的年头比你上牙学院还久。四手操作只有在你真的肯让另外两只手帮忙时才奏效。

text.en: Set a clear rhythm together
text.zh: 一起定个清晰的节奏

resultText.en: You call instruments by name and they're in your palm before you finish the word. Smooth.
resultText.zh: 你叫器械名，话还没说完器械就到了你手心。行云流水。

text.en: Just do everything yourself
text.zh: 干脆全自己来

resultText.en: You reach for your own everything and the assistant stands idle. Slower, lonelier, your call.
resultText.zh: 你什么都自己伸手去拿，助手在旁边闲着。更慢，更孤单，是你的选择。

text.en: Ask the assistant for their tips
text.zh: 向助手请教窍门

resultText.en: They show you a retraction trick worth three lectures. Humility pays interest.
resultText.zh: 他们教你一个抵得上三节课的牵拉小技巧。谦虚是有利息的。

text.en: Your patient pauses at the door, turns, and says they haven't smiled in a photo for years and now they will. They call you doctor. You are very much still a student.
text.zh: 病人在门口停下，回过头，说他们好多年没在照片里笑过了，现在终于能笑了。他们叫你医生。而你其实还是个学生。

text.en: Let yourself feel it
text.zh: 让自己好好感受这一刻

resultText.en: You let the moment in instead of deflecting. This is why the eighty tabs are worth it.
resultText.zh: 你没有岔开话题，而是让这一刻进了心里。这就是那八十个标签页值得的原因。

text.en: Deflect: "It was nothing"
text.zh: 谦虚带过：“没什么啦”

resultText.en: You wave it off out of habit. They look slightly deflated; the gratitude needed a landing pad.
resultText.zh: 你习惯性地摆摆手。他们神色微微一沉，那份感激本需要一个落脚的地方。

text.en: Share the credit with the team
text.zh: 把功劳分给团队

resultText.en: "My faculty and assistant earned this too." Warm, true, and the whole pod stands taller.
resultText.zh: “我的带教和助手也有功劳。”温暖、真诚，整个小组都挺直了腰。

title.zh: 差不多 还是 做对

text.en: It looks fine. It would pass. But that one margin is nagging at you, and the clock is nagging right back.
text.zh: 看着挺好，能过关。可那一处边缘一直在你心里嘀咕，而钟也在那边回嘀咕。

text.en: Redo the margin until it's right
text.zh: 重做那处边缘，直到做对

resultText.en: Extra fifteen minutes, but it's genuinely good now. Your standards just set a little harder.
resultText.zh: 多花了十五分钟，但现在是真的好。你的标准刚刚又硬了一点。

text.en: Let it pass and move on
text.zh: 就这样，过了往下走

resultText.en: It checks off. But the nagging follows you home and sits on the end of the bed.
resultText.zh: 确实过了。可那点嘀咕跟你回了家，坐在床尾。

text.en: Ask faculty if it truly needs redoing
text.zh: 问带教这处到底要不要重做

resultText.en: They show you the threshold that actually matters. Now you'll know on your own next time.
resultText.zh: 他们给你指了真正要紧的那条线。下次你自己就能判断了。

text.en: You realize you've reached for the wrong shade, caught before it mattered but after your stomach already dropped. Nobody's hurt; your pride is just slightly bruised.
text.zh: 你发现自己拿错了比色，在出问题前就察觉了，可你的胃已经先沉了一下。没人受伤，受伤的只是你那点自尊。

text.en: Own it out loud and correct it
text.zh: 大方承认，当场纠正

resultText.en: "Let me grab the right one." Honest and unbothered. The patient trusts you more, not less.
resultText.zh: “我去换正确的那个。”坦荡、不慌。病人反而更信你了，而不是更不信。

text.en: Quietly swap it, mention nothing
text.zh: 悄悄换掉，什么都不说

resultText.en: You fix it silently. No harm done, but the habit of hiding small things is a slippery one.
resultText.zh: 你默默改好了。没造成伤害，但藏小事这个习惯，是会打滑的。

text.en: Flag it to faculty as a learning point
text.zh: 当作学习点报给带教

resultText.en: Faculty respects the honesty and shares a trick to never mix shades up again. Net gain.
resultText.zh: 带教欣赏这份坦诚，还教了你一招再也不弄混比色的方法。净赚。

text.en: Graduation requirements need a certain number of each procedure, and yours are uneven. There's a quiet temptation to see patients as boxes to tick. The tooth can wait; your conscience cannot.
text.zh: 毕业要求每种术式都得攒够数，而你的进度参差不齐。有一股悄悄的诱惑想把病人看成待打钩的格子。牙可以等，你的良心不能。

text.en: Treat the patient, not the checkbox
text.zh: 治病人，不是治那个格子

resultText.en: You do what they need, not what your tally wants. The numbers catch up; your integrity never wobbles.
resultText.zh: 你做的是他们需要的，不是你计数表想要的。数字后来补上了，你的良心一直没晃。

text.en: Steer toward what fills your quota
text.zh: 往能凑指标的方向引导

resultText.en: Your tally improves; something in your gut doesn't. You pass, with an asterisk only you can see.
resultText.zh: 你的计数好看了，胃里却有点不对劲。你过关了，带着一个只有你看得见的星号。

text.en: Ask the clinic coordinator for cases
text.zh: 找诊室协调员帮你匹配病例

resultText.en: They flag suitable patients who genuinely need those procedures. Quota and care, aligned.
resultText.zh: 他们帮你留意真正需要那些术式的合适病例。指标和关怀，对上了。

title.en: The One Who Came Back for You

text.en: A patient from last semester requested you by name for their recall. They drove past two closer clinics because, they say, you actually listened. No pressure or anything.
text.zh: 上学期的一位病人复诊时点名要你。他们说，自己开车路过了两家更近的诊所，就因为你是真的在听。一点压力都没有，真的。

text.en: Meet the trust, take your time
text.zh: 不辜负这份信任，慢慢来

resultText.en: You give them the careful visit they came back for. Being someone's chosen dentist feels like a milestone.
resultText.zh: 你给了他们专程回来求的那种细致诊疗。成为某人指定的牙医，像一个里程碑。

text.en: Tense up under the expectation
text.zh: 在期待下绷紧了

resultText.en: You overthink every move trying to be perfect. Still good care, just a stressful way to give it.
resultText.zh: 你为了完美把每个动作都想过头了。诊疗还是不错，只是把过程做得很紧张。

text.en: Admit you've grown since last time
text.zh: 坦白自己比上次更进步了

resultText.en: "I've learned a lot since I saw you." They love that. Honesty deepens an already-warm rapport.
resultText.zh: “上次见你之后我学了好多。”他们很受用。坦诚让本就温暖的关系更深了。
